# Pickly

> Pickly compares consumer products across 10 categories and publishes the result in up to 17 languages. Every comparison is desk research: we compare published specifications, manufacturer documentation, independent lab tests and verified owner reviews, then rank against explicit criteria (durability, value, comfort), with affiliate disclosure on pages where links earn a commission. **We do not test products ourselves** — where a figure is not published by the manufacturer or an independent lab, we do not state one.

Reviews follow a consistent structure: a ranked comparison of ~5 products, spec tables, pros/cons, FAQs and buying guidance. Widest coverage: /en/, /fr/, /ja/, /ko/, /pt-BR/. Partial editions: /de/, /es/, /it/, /ru/, /zh-CN/, /zh-TW/. Prices and product availability are adapted per market. 4,700 indexed pages.
